06638 tsabah {tsaw-baw'}

字根型; TWOT - 1868; 動詞

AV - swell 2, fight 1; 3

1) 腫起, 腫脹
   1a) (Qal) (姦婦的肚子)腫起
   1b) (Hiphil) 使(姦婦的肚子)腫起

06638 tsabah {tsaw-baw'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 1868; v

AV - swell 2, fight 1; 3

1) to swell, swell up
   1a) (Qal) to swell (of adulteress' belly)
   1b) (Hiphil) to cause to swell (of adulteress' belly)
